== Summary ==
[[Tamás Papp]] (centre, at the laptop) and [[Kevin Jaap]] (right) at the organizers' desk.

* '''Event:''' [[2024 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2024-09-21
* '''Camera date:''' 2024-09-21 (Day 1; posted that evening)
* '''Identification:''' [[Tamás Papp]]: face match with his [[:File:Tamas Papp (community card).jpg|community card]], and he was the tournament director, here working the organizers' desk in the same blue T-shirt all day; [[Kevin Jaap]]: face match with his [[:File:Kevin Jaap 2024 Hall of Fame.jpg|Hall of Fame photo]], where he wears the same white polo.
